newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian deficit shrinks 63.5 pct in Q2 96/7.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian deficit shrinks 63.5 pct in Q2 96/7.

text.p: Egypt's budget deficit shrank to 525 million pounds ($154.6 million) in the second quarter of the 1996/7 financial year compared to a deficit of 1,437 million in the previous quarter, Central Bank figures showed.
The year begins on July 1. The deficit was 600 million pounds for the whole of 1995/6 and 336 million in the second quarter of the same year.
Total expenditure in Q2 1996/7 was 15.946 billion pounds compared to 14.851 billion in the previous quarter. Revenues were 15.421 billion from 13.414 billion in Q1 1996/7.
